tiles.title: Top 10 des étapes de pipelines les plus longues
Répartition de la durée d'exécution des pipelines selon leurs tâches

queries.text:
////////////////////////////////////////////////
// Permets d'avoir pour toutes les pipelines, la durée en moyenne de nos pipelines exécutées par jour
////////////////////////////////////////////////
ItemJobEventLogs
| where ItemKind has "Pipeline"
| where JobStatus == "Completed"
| extend RunDate = startofday(JobStartTime)
| summarize
    AvgDurationMin = round(avg(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    MaxDurationMin = round(max(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    Runs = count()
    by PipelineName = ItemName, PipelineId = ItemId, RunDate
| order by RunDate desc, PipelineName asc

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
// Requête pour récupérer le top 10 des étapes de pipelines les plus longues
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
let PipelineNames = 
    ItemJobEventLogs
    | where ItemKind has "Pipeline"
    | summarize PipelineName = take_any(ItemName)
        by ItemId, WorkspaceId;
FabricDataPipelinesActivityRunsLogs
| where Status == "Succeeded"
| summarize
    AvgDurationMin = round(avg(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    MaxDurationMin = round(max(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    TotalRuns = count()
    by ItemId = ItemName, WorkspaceId, ActivityName, ActivityType
| join kind=leftouter PipelineNames
    on ItemId, WorkspaceId
| project
    PipelineName = PipelineName,
    PipelineId = ItemId,
    ActivityName,
    ActivityType,
    AvgDurationMin,
    MaxDurationMin,
    TotalRuns
| top 10 by AvgDurationMin desc

//////////////////////////////////////////////
// La durée en moyenne de nos différentes activitées dans nos pipelines
//////////////////////////////////////////////
let PipelineNames = 
    ItemJobEventLogs
    | where ItemKind has "Pipeline"
    | summarize PipelineName = take_any(ItemName)
        by ItemId, WorkspaceId;
FabricDataPipelinesActivityRunsLogs
| where Status == "Succeeded"
| summarize
    AvgDurationMin = round(avg(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    MaxDurationMin = round(max(DurationMs) / 60000.0, 2),
    TotalRuns = count()
    by ItemId = ItemName,
       WorkspaceId,
       ActivityName,
       ActivityType
| join kind=leftouter PipelineNames
    on ItemId, WorkspaceId
| project
    PipelineName = PipelineName,
    PipelineId = ItemId,
    ActivityName,
    ActivityType,
    AvgDurationMin,
    MaxDurationMin,
    TotalRuns
| order by AvgDurationMin desc

///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
// Permets d'observer les éléments qui ont échouées
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
let PipelineNames = 
    ItemJobEventLogs
    | where ItemKind has "Pipeline"
    | summarize PipelineName = take_any(ItemName)
        by ItemId, WorkspaceId;
FabricDataPipelinesActivityRunsLogs
| where Status == "Failed"
| extend FailureDate = startofday(OperationStartTime)
| summarize
    ErrorCount = count(),
    FailedActivities = make_set(ActivityName)
    by ItemId = ItemName, WorkspaceId
| join kind=leftouter PipelineNames
    on ItemId, WorkspaceId
| project
    PipelineName = PipelineName,
    PipelineId = ItemId,
    FailedActivities,
    ErrorCount
| order by  ErrorCount desc
